propositions: _fold_heads currently merges bundle heads into the worktree HEAD instead of the published ref tip, making the heal result dependent on the tracker's checked-out branch
_require_tracker_on_ref refuses heals when the current branch differs from the ref (including detached HEAD), preventing heals on off-branch or detached trackers
The fold mechanism must be rewritten to use git merge-tree --write-tree and commit-tree to merge into the published ref without requiring a worktree checkout
Publishing the merged result must handle both on-branch (git reset --hard) and off-branch (git update-ref) cases to keep the worktree consistent only when the ref is checked out
The merge=ours driver configured in .bridge_state/* attributes must be honored during folding, preserving the tracker's side in policy-governed conflicts
After an off-branch heal, the checked-out branch and worktree must remain unmoved; after an on-branch heal, both must advance to the merged tip
